name: Short Cut Samosa Chaat with Chickpea Curry, Pomegranate, Yogurt & Chutney

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE SAMOSAS: Preheat oven according to package instructions. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper and set aside (optional).
Once the oven is heated, arrange samosas on the baking sheet, spacing them about 1-inch apart. Place in the oven and bake according to package instructions.
FOR THE TOPPINGS: While the samosas are cooking, place yogurt, water, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the yogurt sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 pinch cumin, ground
1 pinch salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Place on a plate.
Wash, dry, and shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the plate with the onion.
Add pomegranate seeds to the plate and set aside.

FOR THE CHICKPEAS: When the samosas are almost done, tear a two-inch opening at the top of each pouch to vent. Place both packages in the microwave and heat on high until warmed through, 1-2 minutes. Carefully remove from microwave and set aside to cool slightly. (Alternatively, chickpea tikka masala can be heated in a medium saucepan on the stovetop per package instructions.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (283 g) pouch chickpea tikka masala, ready-to-eat

instructions.primary_message: TO ASSEMBLE THE SAMOSA CHAAT: Divide chickpeas between plates. Carefully cut or break samosas (use a knife if they are too hot to handle with your hands) into bite-sized pieces and arrange over top of the chickpeas. Garnish with toppings (onion, cilantro, and pomegranate seeds) and drizzle with sauces (yogurt, mint, and tamarind chutneys). If your samosas came with a chutney packet, feel free to use that as well!
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mint chutney
⅓ cup tamarind chutney
